description_en: Queries the burstable pay-as-you-go billing details of a subscription WAF instance, such as burstable QPS
description_zh: 查询WAF预付费实例的弹性后付费，如弹性QPS
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-prepay-daily-bills --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePrepayDailyBills

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The WAF instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

Bills.description_en: The list of WAF burstable billing records

ElasticQpsSetValue.description_en: The burstable QPS specification of the WAF instance

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the billing record. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds
EndTime.description_zh: 账单结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒

ExceedStatus.description_en:
The overuse status of the current period. Valid values:
0: Normal.
1: overused.
2: sandboxed
ExceedStatus.description_zh:
当前时段的超用状态。取值：
0：正常。
1：超用。
2：沙箱

ExtensionPlugin.description_en:
Indicates whether the extension plug-in is enabled. Valid values:
true: The extension plug-in is enabled.
false: The extension plug-in is not enabled
ExtensionPlugin.description_zh:
是否开启扩展插件。取值：
true：开启扩展插件。
false：未开启扩展插件

ExtensionPluginRequest.description_en: The number of requests processed by the plug-in

MaxQps.description_en: The maximum QPS during the current period

Price.description_en: The unit price for burstable billing. Unit: CNY for the China site and USD for the international site
Price.description_zh: 弹性计费单价，单位：中国站人民币，国际站美元

Qps.description_en: The QPS extension specification of the WAF instance

QpsVersion.description_en: The QPS specification included in the WAF instance edition

RiskControl.description_en:
Indicates whether risk identification is enabled. Valid values:
true: Risk identification is enabled.
false: Risk identification is not enabled
RiskControl.description_zh:
是否开启风控识别。取值：
true：开启风险识别。
false：未开启风险识别

RiskTraffic.description_en: The number of times risk identification is used

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the billing record. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds
StartTime.description_zh: 账单开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒

Total.description_en: The total QPS that is billed

items.description_en:
The burstable billing type. Valid values:
base: basic traffic.
bot: Bot Management.
apisec: API Security
items.description_zh:
弹性计费类型。取值：
base：基础流量。
bot：Bot管理。
apisec：API安全

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
